# ProSender WhatsApp Bulk Sender and Automation

Welcome to the ProSender AI configuration file. This platform is a comprehensive WhatsApp marketing and automation tool that allows users to send bulk messages, manage templates, automate replies via an intelligent chatbot, and extract leads from Google Maps.

## About Us
ProSender is designed to help businesses manage their WhatsApp outreach efficiently and safely. We prioritize security and compliance to protect WhatsApp numbers from being banned while providing powerful marketing features.

## Capabilities
- **Bulk Messaging:** Send personalized messages to thousands of contacts with attachments.
- **Smart Chatbot:** Set up keyword-based auto-replies.
- **Google Maps Extractor:** Extract business contacts directly from Google Maps.
- **Anti-Spam Features:** Implement delays and variable messaging to avoid bans.
